faqs.question: What types of gym memberships do you offer?
faqs.answer: We offer monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, and yearly gym membership plans based on your fitness goals.

faqs.question: How can I join the gym?
faqs.answer: You can join the gym by visiting the reception, filling out a registration form, and selecting a membership plan.

faqs.question: Can I join the gym online?
faqs.answer: Yes, online registration is available through our website or mobile app depending on the gym facility.

faqs.question: How much is the gym membership fee?
faqs.answer: Membership fees vary based on the plan duration, facilities, and services included.

faqs.question: Do you offer a free trial session?
faqs.answer: Yes, many gyms offer a free trial or demo session for new members before joining.

faqs.question: What documents are required to join the gym?
faqs.answer: A valid ID proof, passport size photo, and basic registration details are usually required.

faqs.question: Is there any age limit for gym membership?
faqs.answer: Most gyms accept members above 16 or 18 years depending on the policy, with special plans for seniors.

faqs.question: Is a personal trainer included in membership?
faqs.answer: Personal training is usually available as an add-on service and may not be included in basic membership.

faqs.question: What are the benefits of gym membership?
faqs.answer: Benefits include access to equipment, group classes, fitness guidance, and a healthy lifestyle environment.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my gym membership?
faqs.answer: Yes, membership cancellation is possible based on gym policies and terms and conditions.

faqs.question: Can I pause or freeze my membership?
faqs.answer: Yes, some gyms allow membership freezing due to travel, illness, or personal reasons.

faqs.question: What payment methods are accepted?
faqs.answer: Cash, card payments, UPI, and online transfers are commonly accepted.

faqs.question: When can I use the gym after joining?
faqs.answer: You can use the gym during working hours based on your selected membership plan.

faqs.question: What facilities are included in membership?
faqs.answer: Facilities may include cardio equipment, strength training machines, locker rooms, and group classes.

faqs.question: How do I renew my gym membership?
faqs.answer: You can renew your membership at the reception or through online payment options before expiry.

faqs.question: What are your gym opening hours?
faqs.answer: Our gym is usually open from early morning to late evening, with timings varying based on weekdays and weekends.

faqs.question: What time does the gym close?
faqs.answer: The gym typically closes in the evening, but exact closing time may vary depending on the day and membership plan.

faqs.question: Are gym timings different on weekends?
faqs.answer: Yes, weekend timings may differ slightly from weekdays and may be adjusted based on demand.

faqs.question: What are peak hours in the gym?
faqs.answer: Peak hours are usually early morning and evening when most members prefer to work out.

faqs.question: Are there off-peak hours for less crowd?
faqs.answer: Yes, mid-morning and afternoon hours are generally less crowded and more comfortable for workouts.

faqs.question: Do all members get 24/7 gym access?
faqs.answer: 24/7 access depends on your membership plan. Some plans include round-the-clock access.

faqs.question: How do I enter the gym?
faqs.answer: Members can enter the gym using membership ID, access card, or biometric verification depending on the facility.

faqs.question: Can I bring a guest to the gym?
faqs.answer: Guest access is allowed in some plans, but prior approval or guest pass may be required.

faqs.question: Do you offer trial access before joining?
faqs.answer: Yes, trial passes or one-day access may be available for new users.

faqs.question: Is the gym open on public holidays?
faqs.answer: Gym availability on public holidays depends on management policy and may have reduced hours.

faqs.question: Are there any access rules for the gym?
faqs.answer: Yes, members must follow gym rules including proper attire, hygiene standards, and safety guidelines.

faqs.question: Can I enter the gym late at night?
faqs.answer: Late-night access is available only for members with 24/7 access plans.

faqs.question: Is there a time limit per gym session?
faqs.answer: Some gyms may have session limits during peak hours, while others allow unlimited workout time.

faqs.question: Can I access all gym equipment anytime?
faqs.answer: Yes, all equipment is generally accessible during operating hours unless under maintenance.

faqs.question: When is gym staff available for assistance?
faqs.answer: Trainers and staff are usually available during peak hours, and support may be limited during off-peak times.
